description: React component for rendering and managing the post view in a chat channel, including loading states and scroll position handling.

classes.name: PostView
classes.description: React component extending React.PureComponent to display and manage chat posts, including scroll position and loading states.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes component state based on props, particularly scroll position and loading status.

methods.name: getDerivedStateFromProps
methods.description: Synchronizes state with incoming props, especially last viewed timestamp and loading status.

methods.name: changeUnreadChunkTimeStamp
methods.description: Updates the unread chunk timestamp and manages loading indicator during update.

methods.name: toggleShouldStartFromBottomWhenUnread
methods.description: Toggles the scroll position preference and manages loading indicator during toggle.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders loading screen if loading; otherwise renders PostList component with current state and props.
